brief: Prioritise Oakhurst Point for pre-event attention ahead of the forecast heat event, as its advanced age of 44 years reduces its margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. Inspect the asset for outstanding work orders and complete any items relating to failed cooling, obstructed ventilation, or oil level and leaks before the event begins [SOP-016]. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
